headline.title: A Google Cloud “power event” in London knocks UK bank apps offline
headline.quip: Banks, the post and the courts all went down together. Britain’s institutions finally share something: one data center.
headline.summary: Google Cloud zone europe-west2-b in London failed from 23:08 PDT on October 19, the morning of October 20 in the UK; most workloads recovered by 05:10 PDT. Revolut card payments and ATM withdrawals, Lloyds, Halifax, Bank of Scotland, HSBC, Royal Mail, DPD and court video hearings in England and Wales were affected. Google described a “power event” and called it a third-party issue.
